dct_description_sm: "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1856 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the Clerk's Office of the District Court of the eastern district of Pennsylvania."

"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1856 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the Clerk's Office of the District Court of the eastern district of Pennsylvania." Accompanied by some cut-out portions of maps that shows the main title. Includes business directories, population statistical table, insets of Lucas, Mansfield, Lexington, Independence, Plymouth, Belle Ville, Shelby, Newville, Ontario, Olivesburgh, Rome, views of public, residential, and commercial properties.
